panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Live goroutines in the owl process. A steady, low line means the worker pool is healthy; a slow climb usually means a goroutine leak.

panels.title: Heap allocated
panels.description: Bytes of live heap objects, before GC. Reflects the Go process working set, not Linux RSS — file-cache attribution is excluded.

panels.title: GC pause (last 5 min)
panels.description: Total seconds spent in GC stop-the-world pauses over the last 5 minutes. Persistent spikes here translate directly into request-latency jitter.

panels.title: Samples in storage
panels.description: Rows in the SQLite samples table. Climbs until a retention policy starts pruning.

panels.title: Storage size on disk
panels.description: On-disk size of the SQLite database. The shape of this line is the canonical signal for the dual time/size retention policy.

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: Distinct (rule, series) lineages currently in the firing state. Should be 0 most of the time.

panels.title: Alerter evaluations / s
panels.description: Rate of alert-rule evaluation cycles. A flat line at zero (when rules are configured) means the alerter has stopped looping.

panels.title: Webhook activity
panels.description: Webhook deliveries per second, split between successful sends and failures. A sustained failures line over zero means the webhook receiver is unreachable or rejecting events.
